```artifact
**Test Suite for Unit U08_Alarms**

**Test Case ID** | **Test Case Title** | **Requirement ID** | **Test Case Type** | **Preconditions** | **Input Data** | **Steps** | **Expected Result**
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
TC-001 | Verify Low Pressure Alarm Logs Onset and Reset | RW-SW-85 | Positive | System is running | N/A | 1. Simulate low pressure. 2. Verify alarm is logged on. 3. Simulate pressure recovery. 4. Verify alarm is reset. | Alarm logged on and then reset.
TC-002 | Trigger Low Pressure Alarm with High Priority | RW-SW-86 | Positive | System is running | N/A | 1. Simulate low inspiratory pressure. 2. Verify alarm is triggered with high priority. | Alarm triggered with high priority.
TC-003 | Compute Pressure High Alarm with Threshold Exceeded | RW-SW-88 | Positive | System is running | N/A | 1. Simulate pressure exceeding threshold for 3 consecutive breaths. 2. Verify alarm is active. | Alarm active.
TC-004 | Sound Emission with Pressure High Alarm | RW-SW-89 | Positive | System is running | N/A | 1. Simulate pressure exceeding threshold for 3 consecutive breaths. 2. Verify sound is emitted. | Sound emitted.
TC-005 | Display Pressure High Alarm Until Cancelled | RW-SW-90 | Positive | System is running | N/A | 1. Simulate pressure exceeding threshold for 3 consecutive breaths. 2. Cancel alarm. 3. Verify alarm is inactive. | Alarm displayed until cancelled.
TC-006 | Support Alarm State with Visible but Non-Audible Alarm | RW-SW-91 | Positive | System is running | N/A | 1. Simulate alarm state with visible but non-audible alarm. 2. Verify alarm is visible but not audible. | Alarm visible but not audible.
TC-007 | PIP Too High Alarm with High Priority | RW-SW-93 | Positive | System is running | N/A | 1. Set commanded PIP value. 2. Simulate PIP exceeding threshold. 3. Verify alarm is triggered with high priority. | Alarm triggered with high priority.
TC-008 | Default Value for PIP Too High Alarm | RW-SW-94 | Positive | System is running | N/A | 1. Verify default value for PIP too high alarm is commanded PIP value + 5cm H2O. | Default value is commanded PIP value + 5cm H2O.
```
